name: agent-guide-drift-check
body:
Agent-guide drift self-test: a build/test-time self-test fails when either embedded guide (the deck `AGENTS.md`, agent-authoring, or the library `AGENTS.md`, library-agent-guide) drifts from the format the code implements. Modeled on the package-init self-test `validateSeed()` in internal/scaffold/helloseed.go (which panics at package load when the embedded hello seed stops loading), it asserts at minimum that every token the implemented format defines appears in the relevant guide — every field type (field-types), the reserved names `deck`/`slide`, the v1 helper `media`, the reserved context keys `.deck.title`/`.deck.author`/`.deck.date`/`.deck.properties`/`.slide.number`/`.slide.total`, every `kalide.yaml` key (`title`, `author`, `date`, `theme`, `navigation`, `properties`, `templates`), the `template.yaml` top-level keys and body modes, and every CLI command (`init`, `init-library`, `start`, `templates`, `templates <name>`, `version`) — and that the guides' example snippets still load/validate. It runs in the build/test gate, not at runtime in a user's project, so it cannot be defeated by editing a scaffolded `AGENTS.md`.

AC: removing a documented token (e.g. a field type or the `media` helper) from a guide, or adding a format token the guide omits, makes the self-test fail.
